about_the_game:
Meet Bea!

Meet Bea — a spoiled little darling who always gets what she wants. She’s used to the sweet life: black cards, luxury getaways, and scandalously tailored outfits straight off the runway.

She’s buzzing in with her naughtiest look yet — a barely-there honeybee costume that’s guaranteed to make heads turn. But the real show starts when she starts licking honey off her stick...The only thing she’ll lick with more devotion is your “big stick”!

Bea doesn’t like to wait. She demands attention, adoration, gifts — and a very particular kind of treatment. If boredom strikes, she’ll sting… and cut you off from the sweet stuff. Shower her with compliments. Tell her no one in the world could ever match her beauty and irresistible charm. Do it right — and Bea might just forgive your little mistakes, tuck away her stinger, and give you everything you've been craving./p]


WHAT YOU'RE GETTING?

By purchasing this DLC, you unlock Bea in her naughty bee outfit. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in-game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
